Higher operating costs without growth in sales was the stated reason for the decline in operating margin, net margin and return on net worth in FY26.
- Intense competition from domestic as well as international manufacturers, including low-cost imports, exerts pressure on pricing, margins and market share. Competitive pricing pressure is also one of the risks the Board reviewed during the year.
- Managing receivables and ensuring timely collection of dues from customers remain important areas of focus given the nature of the business and the project execution cycle; working capital management and liquidity constraints are listed among the key risks faced by the Company.
- Supply chain disruptions are named among the key risks; during FY26 logistics constraints and pressure on supply chains impacted operational efficiencies and project execution timelines.
- The Company cites fluctuations in foreign exchange rates among the challenges it faces, relevant given imports/technology licences from Bauer (Germany) and CAPA (Spain) and sales to customers overseas.
- Changes in regulatory policies are listed among the key risks; the cautionary statement further flags changes in government regulations, tax laws and the political environment as factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from expectations.
